hero.alt: University of Maryland students walking together on campus
hero.headline: Admission Representatives
hero.text: Our admission counselors are traveling the globe to find the next class of fearless Terps!

paragraphs: Your admission representative can answer your questions, offer advice and guide you through the admission process. We understand selecting a college is a big decision, but it doesn’t have to be a stressful one. Learn more about each of our reps, and the territories they cover, on their profile pages.

To get in touch with your admission representative, simply email ApplyMaryland@umd.edu and include your city and state in the subject line (for example, “Student Inquiry from College Park, Maryland”).

promo.headline: Stay in touch with UMD
promo.text: Complete a brief form to be added to UMD's mailing list. We'll send you emails about upcoming events, deadlines and helpful information about applying to UMD.
